sections.title: Azure certification study packs
sections.intro: One book and one lab workbook for each exam. Read the book first, then do the labs in a free Azure account.

packs.title: Azure Fundamentals
packs.summary: A picture-rich first step into Azure: cloud concepts, Azure architecture and services, and Azure management and governance. The labs are free-account friendly.

packs.title: Azure Administrator
packs.summary: Azure administration, picture first: identity, governance, storage, compute, networking, monitoring and backup. The labs are step by step, in the portal.

packs.title: Azure Networking
packs.summary: Builds networking skills one module at a time, starting from what a network is. The labs go from a first virtual network to VPNs, load balancers, private endpoints and Azure Firewall, all in the portal.

packs.title: Azure Solutions Architect
packs.summary: A design book for going from administrator to architect: identity, governance, monitoring, data, business continuity, compute, application architecture, migration and networking, with decision trees, scenarios and case studies. The 20 design labs end in a full capstone.

files.title: Azure Solutions Architect: Zero to AZ-305

packs.title: DevOps Engineer Expert
packs.summary: A YAML-first book covering Azure DevOps and GitHub side by side: flow, source control, pipelines, deployments, infrastructure as code, security and monitoring. The labs include AI-assisted DevOps.

files.title: DevOps Engineer Expert: Zero to AZ-400

packs.title: Cloud and AI Security Engineer
packs.summary: Security controls from end to end: identity, Key Vault, governance, storage, databases, networks, servers, containers, AI apps and agents, Defender for Cloud, Sentinel and Security Copilot.

files.title: Cloud & AI Security Engineer: Zero to SC-500
Cloud & AI Security Engineer Labs Workbook

packs.title: Azure AI Apps and Agents Developer
packs.summary: A code-first book in Python: Foundry models, RAG, agents and multi-agent workflows, responsible AI, vision, speech, text and document extraction. The labs are runnable code.

files.title: Azure AI Apps & Agents Developer: Zero to AI-103
Azure AI Apps & Agents Labs Workbook

packs.title: Azure AI Cloud Developer
packs.summary: A code-first book in Python: containers, vector databases, messaging, serverless, security and observability on Azure. The labs are runnable code.

files.title: Azure AI Cloud Developer: Zero to AI-200
Azure AI Cloud Developer Labs Workbook

packs.title: Machine Learning Operations Engineer
packs.summary: A code-first book on Azure Machine Learning MLOps and Microsoft Foundry GenAIOps: infrastructure as code, training, deployment, monitoring, evaluation, tracing, RAG and fine-tuning.

files.title: Machine Learning Operations Engineer: Zero to AI-300

packs.title: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect
packs.summary: An architecture book on planning, designing and deploying agentic business solutions: strategy, ROI, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Foundry, Dynamics 365 and Power Platform agents, testing, ALM and responsible AI.

files.title: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect: Zero to AB-100
Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect Labs Workbook

sections.title: Projects, Python and interviews
sections.intro: Books that go with the study packs: build something, learn the Python behind AI systems, and prepare for the interview.

packs.title: Azure Real-World Projects
packs.summary: Twenty portfolio projects that use almost every major Azure service, each with an architecture, a build plan, acceptance tests and guidance on tiers, load and limits. A companion to all the study packs.

packs.title: Python for AI Engineers
packs.summary: Beginner to advanced, concepts first and then interview questions: basics, the data model, decorators, typing and Pydantic, testing, packaging, memory and the GIL, threads, processes, asyncio, free-threading, FastAPI and LLM engineering patterns.

packs.title: AI Engineer Interview Playbook
packs.summary: For AI and GenAI engineer roles, from screen call to offer: 350 interview questions with strong answers, follow-ups and red flags, 117 rapid-fire drills, 60 real-world scenarios, an 80-term Azure bank, eight whiteboard system designs, coding exercises, a STAR story bank and a four-week plan.
